findings.tourismPurposeMovement: Collected normally: the daily run reads the official OA-22378 page and reports SKIPPED_NO_NEW_PUBLICATION for publication 202609 (runs 38489053016, 38337292739); the stored value (reference date 2026-09-30) was hidden only because the unit had not been confirmed.
unitEvidence: Seoul Open Data living-mobility description (data.seoul.go.kr/dataVisual/seoul/seoulLivingMigration.do, via search): the count is 이동인구(합); values of 3 people or fewer are masked with * for privacy; the data is a statistical estimate from KT LTE/5G signals and can differ from reality.
Press coverage of the Seoul/KT 수도권 생활이동 release (etnews 2024-05-28): 이동인구 = how many people moved between origin and destination, aggregated from mobile signals.
The OA-22378 CSV values are decimals (e.g. 360.5), consistent with expansion-weighted people estimates; masked cells are the non-numeric rows the parser already excludes.
findings.shortStayForeignLivingPopulation: Not a display bug: every daily run (e.g. 38489053016) tries the 62 latest days at 23:00 and gets no rows for any date after 2026-08-26 (49 candidates, 53 requests), so the newest complete period is 2026-08-26 23:00. Seoul's living-population pages announce the move to the national 250 m grid (old products ended after 2026-07-31); whether OA-23018 resumes or is replaced is not confirmed from this environment (data.seoul.go.kr is unreachable here).
